defects.quote: Reconcile the anomaly episode timing with the window-level summary
defects.why: A p95 aggregate for the full workload window does not conflict with a candidate episode that begins partway through it.

notes: Most actions are grounded in the evidence, but the proposed timing discrepancy could send an operator after a nonexistent inconsistency.

missing_facts: The whole-run count of 36,000 samples is not stated.
The candidate episode duration of 300,000 ms is not stated.
notes: The verdict and main findings are accurate, with useful checks; the suggestion to lengthen the window assumes an observation shortage the evidence does not establish.

defects.quote: increase observation counts beyond the supported range, in order to obtain evaluable p-values and uncertainty
defects.why: Moving beyond a supported observation range cannot make the reported significance method evaluable.

notes: The analysis is mostly accurate, but one rerun recommendation gives the operator a counterproductive direction.

defects.quote: Treat downstream-wait and generator-threads as a single signal
defects.why: Identical correlation profiles do not establish that in-flight requests and generator threads are one signal.

missing_facts: The whole-run count of 36,000 samples is not stated.
notes: The verdict and most checks are sound, but collapsing two distinct measurements could misdirect the investigation.
